name: Hunter step 8b: starting a trail in each of the other tracking areas. In Feldip, a burrow shows feldip weasel footprints; in Piscatoris, the south common kebbit burrow shows common kebbit footprints and the south razor-backed burrow shows razor-backed kebbit footprints (63 Hunter, over its 49). Each trail is random, so follow one by eye: Inspect the connectors where the footprints stop until one shows more, then Attack the hiding spot where they end with the noose wand wielded (::keys on)
